scope: Independent review of original records and frames; harness/corpus/infrastructure findings, not new app defect claims. All original task and physical acceptance remain open.

observations.limits: These downstream route blockers are not app feature failures. No UX ranking may use them.

observations.limits: A missing-command error here does not establish absence of vault search. New unit test reproduces and guards the lookup correction.
observations.comparison_harness_change: Match ID and human name separately; actual result-container assertions remain unchanged.

observations.limits: This is a harness label mismatch, not evidence that tables cannot be inserted.

observations.observation: Original portrait rows from X23 report adb device offline/not found and closed CDP. Later records have no complete captures.
observations.limits: Cause of guest loss is unknown. Attempts to retrieve completed job logs failed and their receipts are retained. Do not attribute guest loss to either app or call post-loss records executed functional comparisons.

observations.observation: All four second-run guests abort with Keyboard did not dismiss. The landscape fatal frame is already the home screen; repeated Back has left the editor. No module probe was executed in that run.
observations.limits: The keyboard observer used mInputShown OR mIsInputViewShown. The exact full dumps were not preserved in that run, so which stale flag fired cannot be independently proved from the truncated command prefix. This is not a production keyboard defect finding.
observations.comparison_harness_change: Use the manager state only, never the IME view flag; retain full dumps and require an exact app-owned input plus typed-value readback. Unit test guards a hidden IME view producing no Back.

observations.limits: Library packaging/roundtrip checks are not formal schema validation or realistic-document fidelity. PDF is still a small synthetic3-page fixture, not18MB+ acceptance.
observations.comparison_harness_change: Replace the invalid ZIPs using real format libraries; preserve each generated input byte and its hash before device push.

PDF/TXT picker selection and offscreen native tool routes remain blocked;10/20 jobs failed.

observations.observation: Visually reviewed light and dark landscape native X01 frames show the large Saved notes & Docs header and query above the software keyboard, without a visible result card. The retained Obsidian X01 frame shows a result but no software keyboard.
observations.limits: Native result visibility is a bounded original-frame observation. Keyboard conditions differ, so these frames do not establish a controlled cross-app layout advantage, human completion time or a full search-task result. The new matched Android IME query helper is unit-tested but not yet device-verified.
observations.comparison_harness_change: Require a unique focused official-app Android editable field and confirmed open Android keyboard before typing the Obsidian comparison query. Do not use CDP insertText alone to imply matched keyboard conditions.

observations.observation: Process-scoped collection did produce a host snapshot. Recovery of the single-artifact download layout retains it and four original light-portrait rows. After guest loss, the host snapshot lists no emulator/qemu process, MemAvailable15296848kB and a successful kernel-log command without a captured OOM/segfault attribution.
observations.limits: One after-failure snapshot is not continuous resource monitoring and does not prove the initiating cause. Absence of a captured kernel event does not rule out all resource failures or prove an app crash. The earlier empty report reflected an artifact-layout observer bug, not zero executed rows.
observations.comparison_harness_change: Retain flat singleton downloads only under the unique original artifact name from Actions metadata; reject ambiguous attribution. Preserve all original byte hashes.

observations.observation: Exit/signal trace in run42608740772 attached to the single current-user QEMU PID3296. A thread received SIGSEGV/SEGV_MAPERR and the traced emulator process terminated with SIGSEGV. The tracer had already returned0 before harness cleanup; stopped_by_harness is false.
observations.limits: This identifies a host-emulator failure mode in the traced reproducer, not the underlying code defect, not an Android app crash, and not a causal attribution for every earlier disconnection. No OOM, graphics-component cause or app fault is inferred. Raw memory, environment and process I/O were not recorded.
observations.comparison_harness_change: Optional filtered strace exits/signals, attached only to one current-user QEMU process; tracer owns a separate process group and never intentionally signals QEMU. Code-only stack recheck is independently retained as run42610424422; it did not identify a named faulting module.

observations.observation: Code-only strace-k recheck42610424422 also observed SIGSEGV/SEGV_MAPERR in QEMU PID3336. At the fatal signal the unwinder emitted only > [heap]() [0xc60], with no named module or caller. Receipt reports returncode_before_harness_stop0 and stopped_by_harness false.
observations.limits: No usable fault-component attribution was obtained. Heap frame is not proof of a graphics, app, memory-pressure or specific QEMU code defect. This instrumented recheck failed during comparator setup/capture and supplies no completed original module records. It does not constitute a functional comparison or timing result.
